title:
A wrapper on top of window performance APIs.
NOTE:
   measure_perf cookie needs to be set to true to enable APIs.
USAGE:
   import * as UiSdlPerformance from "@c3/ui/UiSdlPerformance";

   UiSdlPerformance.mark('mark1')
   UiSdlPerformance.mark('mark2')
   UiSdlPerformance.measure('measure1', 'mark1', 'mark2')
name: UiSdlPerformance
